subject.title: fix: declare archive-sync feature for daytona provider

question: Should Daytona officially advertise both `FeatureCrabboxSync` and `FeatureArchiveSync` while remaining `ProviderKindSSHLease`, with the test contract allowing SSH-lease archive-sync hybrids?
rationale: The code change matches Daytona's direct toolbox sync and brokered SSH sync behavior, but it changes the public provider feature contract and future provider invariant; automation should not make that taxonomy decision without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept dual-sync Daytona hybrid
options.body: Treat Daytona as a supported SSH-lease provider with brokered Crabbox rsync and direct toolbox archive sync, then require live proof before merge.

options.title: Use a narrower Daytona exception
options.body: Keep the useful Daytona behavior but avoid broadening the general SSH-lease archive-sync invariant beyond this provider until the contract is documented.

options.title: Defer to provider coverage work
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader provider lifecycle and metadata drift thread defines the permanent feature taxonomy.

recommendation.title: Accept dual-sync Daytona hybrid
recommendation.body: Treat Daytona as a supported SSH-lease provider with brokered Crabbox rsync and direct toolbox archive sync, then require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Daytona implementation, provider matrix work, and latest branch correction all point to this owner as the best available decision route.
